en: n. the amount by which money spent is greater than money received; the amount by which something is less than what is needed; a lack of something that is needed
ex: The government is trying to reduce the budget deficit.
政府正設法削減預算赤字。

en: n. a set of moving parts in a machine that performs a particular job; a way of doing something; a system of parts that work together; a natural process that causes something
ex: The clock has a complicated mechanism inside.
這個時鐘裡面有複雜的機械結構。

en: n. a machine that is designed to do a particular job in the home, such as a washing machine or a refrigerator; a device used for a particular purpose
ex: The shop sells kitchen appliances like blenders and toasters.
這家店賣果汁機和烤麵包機這類廚房電器。

en: n. a person who is held prisoner by someone who demands something in exchange for freeing them; something given as a guarantee that a promise will be kept
ex: The kidnappers held three people as hostages.
綁匪把三個人當作人質。

en: a. existing in large amounts; more than enough; (of a place) having a lot of something
ex: The country has abundant natural resources.
這個國家有豐富的天然資源。

en: a. used as a symbol of something; relating to symbols; having a deeper meaning than what is obvious
ex: The dove is a symbolic bird that stands for peace.
鴿子是象徵和平的鳥。

en: n. a list of things to be discussed at a meeting; a plan of things to be done; a list of items; a person's reasons for doing something
ex: The first item on the agenda is the budget.
議程上的第一項是預算。

en: n. wild animals and plants that live in their natural environment; wild creatures in general
ex: The national park is rich in wildlife.
這座國家公園有豐富的野生動物。

en: n. a substance that can flow, such as water or oil; a. able to flow like water; (of a situation) likely to change; smooth and graceful
ex: Drink plenty of fluids when you have a fever.
發燒時要多喝水。

en: n. a small oval green or black fruit used for food and oil; the tree that produces this fruit; a dull yellowish-green color; a. having the color of an olive
ex: She added olives to the salad.
她在沙拉裡加了橄欖。

en: n. the movement of people from one place to another; the regular movement of animals between places; the movement of data between systems
ex: Bird migration begins in the autumn.
鳥類遷徙從秋天開始。

en: a. relating to government money, especially taxes and public spending; relating to money in general
ex: The government announced a new fiscal policy.
政府宣布了新的財政政策。

en: n. the chance that something will or will not happen; the probability of winning; a difference or inequality; the amount by which one thing is greater than another
ex: The odds of winning the lottery are very small.
中樂透的機率非常小。

en: n. an experienced person who gives advice and help to someone with less experience; a trusted counselor or teacher; vt. to give advice and support to someone with less experience
ex: She has been my mentor since I started my career.
自從我開始工作以來，她一直是我的導師。

en: n. the state of feeling bored; a feeling of being tired because something is not interesting; something that is boring
ex: He played games on his phone to escape boredom.
他玩手機遊戲來排遣無聊。

en: a. polite and showing respect for other people; behaving in a respectful and thoughtful way
ex: The waiter was courteous and attentive.
服務生有禮貌又周到。

en: n. a person or company that makes an agreement to do work or supply goods; a person who agrees to do a job for payment; a person who builds houses or buildings
ex: The contractor finished the building ahead of schedule.
承包商提前完成了建築工程。

en: n. a substance that plants and animals need to live and grow; something that provides energy and helps the body grow; a. providing food or nourishment
ex: Fruit and vegetables provide important nutrients.
蔬菜和水果提供重要營養素。

en: n. a promise or firm decision to do something; a strong belief in something and willingness to work hard for it; something that you have promised to do; the act of sending someone to a prison or hospital
ex: She showed great commitment to her studies.
她對學業表現出極大的投入。

en: n. an animal that hunts and kills other animals for food; a person or organization that tries to harm or take advantage of others; an animal that preys on weaker animals
ex: The lion is a top predator in the savanna.
獅子是大草原上的頂級掠食者。

en: vi. to fly high in the air; to rise quickly to a high level; to increase greatly in value or amount; to rise in a smooth and graceful way; n. an act of flying high
ex: Housing prices continue to soar in the city.
這座城市的房價持續飆升。

en: n. a standard by which something is judged or decided; a principle or rule used to decide something; (plural: criteria)
ex: What criteria do you use to choose a candidate?
你用什麼標準來挑選候選人？

en: a. the smallest possible in amount or degree; very small in size or amount; (of art) using very few elements
ex: The damage to the building was minimal.
建築物受到的損害非常輕微。

en: prep. by way of a particular place; by means of a particular person or method; through a particular route
ex: We flew to Tokyo via Hong Kong.
我們經由香港飛往東京。

en: n. a difference between things; the quality of being excellent; a special mark of honor given to someone for excellence; the act of showing that things are different
ex: There is a clear distinction between right and wrong.
對與錯之間有清楚的區別。

en: n. a difference in the amount or level of something; a change from the normal; a different form of something; a musical piece based on a theme
ex: There is a lot of variation in temperature during the day.
白天的氣溫變化很大。

en: a. causing a lot of disagreement or argument; likely to cause argument; relating to something people have different opinions about
ex: The new law is highly controversial among voters.
這項新法在選民之間引發高度爭議。

en: a. having no limit or end; extremely great in amount or degree; (grammar) not limited by tense or number; n. something that is endless; God
ex: The universe is infinite and always expanding.
宇宙是無窮無盡且不斷擴張的。

en: n. the act of becoming involved in a situation in order to change or stop something; the act of coming between two things; an official action taken to improve a situation
ex: The government's intervention helped to end the strike.
政府的介入幫助結束了罷工。

en: n. the fact of looking or being similar; a way in which two things are alike; (old use) a picture of a person
ex: There is a strong resemblance between the two brothers.
這兩兄弟長得非常像。

en: n. a period when the economy of a country is not successful; the act of moving back or going away; a part of a wall that is set back; the process of becoming less
ex: The country fell into a recession after the financial crisis.
金融危機後，這個國家陷入經濟衰退。

en: a. relating to the making of laws; having the power to make laws; n. a group of people who have the power to make laws
ex: The legislative process can take months or even years.
立法過程可能需要數月甚至數年。

en: n. something that helps someone remember something; something that makes you think of something; a letter sent to remind someone to pay a bill
ex: The calendar is a daily reminder of her busy schedule.
月曆每天提醒她行程很滿。

en: a. not damaged or broken; complete and not missing any part; in its original state
ex: The ancient vase was still intact after two thousand years.
那件古代花瓶在兩千年後依然完好。

en: n. a person who takes the place of someone else in a job or position; a person who inherits a title or property; a thing that comes after another thing and takes its place
ex: The king named his eldest son as his successor.
國王指定長子為繼位人。

en: n. a person or organization that pays for a show, event or research; a person who supports someone else; vt. to give money to support a person, event or activity; to promise to help someone
ex: The company is the main sponsor of the sports event.
這家公司是這項運動賽事的主要贊助商。

en: n. a confused mass of things that are twisted together; a confused situation; a dispute; vt. to twist things into a confused mass; vi. to become twisted together
ex: The cat got tangled up in a ball of yarn.
貓被纏在一團毛線裡。

en: vt. to imagine something that may happen in the future; to form a picture of something in your mind; to predict something
ex: I can't envision myself living in a big city.
我無法想像自己住在大城市。

en: a. only available to a particular person or group; expensive and for rich people only; not shared with anyone else; excluding something; n. an exclusive news story
ex: The club is exclusive and only accepts a few new members each year.
這個俱樂部很高級，每年只收少數新會員。

en: vt. to catch up with and go past a moving vehicle or person; to happen suddenly to someone; to become greater than someone or something; to overcome someone
ex: The truck tried to overtake the car on the bend.
卡車試圖在彎道上超車。
